# OFFICIAL SURVIVAL GEAR [italic]The same kit Rex carries on Hostile Worlds, give or take a camera crew. Prices in UA dollars. Shipped with the next freighter, packed in a crate Rex has personally kicked to make sure it holds.[/italic]
## CUT
- [bold]The Maddox Machete[/bold], $55. For vines, brush and opening crates. Rex does not recommend it for anything else and neither does your colony's Colonial Marshal. - [bold]Base Camp Knife[/bold], $30. Season one's knife. The one he broke on a rock in episode two, rebuilt to be harder to break on a rock.
## SEE AND BE SEEN
- [bold]Signal Flares[/bold], $4 each. Rule two. Light it before you need it. - [bold]Ridgeline Binoculars[/bold], $40. So you can see the thing before the thing sees you.
## EAT
- [bold]Rex Ration[/bold], $6. A standard meal ready to eat in a Hostile Worlds sleeve. Rex has signed the sleeve. Rex has not changed the meal. It is still the most dangerous thing he has eaten on the show.
## WEAR
- [bold]The Boonie[/bold], $20. Rex's hat. The real one has a burn mark from the Cold Night flare. Yours does not, unless you try very hard. - [bold]I Was Not Lost Shirt[/bold], $18. Printed after the Green Hell episode. Sales have been excellent. The garrison at Lazarus Landing bought a box.
## A WORD FROM OUR SAFETY OFFICER Owning the gear does not make you Rex. If you are on a colony world, the best survival kit you have is your colony administration, your garrison and the clinic. Stay inside the perimeter after dark.
